title: exudev scripts --fix: AddRevoluteJoint, AddPrismaticJoint and CSRtoScipySparseCSR
author: Claude-JG
description: Also rewrite AddRevoluteJoint (to mbs.CreateRevoluteJoint, which returns the joint instead of [joint, marker0, marker1]) and CSRtoScipySparseCSR; the lecture scripts call CSRtoScipySparseCSR(fem.GetMassMatrix(sparse=True)), and one defines a function of that name itself, which the checker reported as the deprecated one
releaseNotes: exudev scripts --fix replaces AddRevoluteJoint and AddPrismaticJoint by mbs.CreateRevoluteJoint/CreatePrismaticJoint (markers read from the joint) and drops CSRtoScipySparseCSR around the matrices of the FEM interface; a function the script defines itself is not taken for the library's. revision2026c step RG10.31.13
